name: Pleasanteas | 30mg Tea | Lemon
description:
30mg Infused Tea

Our lemon iced tea is a fresh take on a summer classic with fresh lemon zing and a sweet tea finish. It’s the perfect reward for finishing your yard work early on a Saturday.

--

Pleasanteas are best served ice cold & enjoyed with your friends. Cheers!
